outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: The page’s visible date chips don’t show the year, but the URL parameters do encode 2026, so that’s not an issue. Also, if Booking.com lacks a true total-stay budget filter, using per-night budget or manual selection based on displayed total prices would be acceptable.

Critical issues: The agent did not deliver the primary deliverable—no three-hotel comparison and no recommendation. Evidence shows the agent successfully set the correct search (Amsterdam; Sep 15 to Sep 18, 2026; 2 adults; 1 room) and applied the “Very Good: 8+” filter (URL includes nflt=review_score=80 and filter text is visible). However, there is no evidence the budget-below-€750 constraint was actually applied via filters, and the agent also did not manually enforce it by selecting and comparing three under-€750 properties. Most importantly, the agent never opened three hotel detail pages and never produced the required comparison across cancellation terms and distance from center, nor did it recommend a hotel. Although the results list shows some qualifying hotels and even some cancellation snippets for at least one listing, the agent’s final output is essentially an inability-to-proceed report rather than the requested comparison/recommendation.

Overall outcome: The agent completed only the initial search setup and one filter; it failed to complete the comparison and recommendation steps that are the task’s main goal. From an average user perspective, the task was not successfully completed.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use Booking.com to find Amsterdam hotels for Sep 15–18, 2026 (3 nights) for 2 adults/1 room, apply an 8+ guest rating filter and a total-budget-under-€750 constraint where possible, then open three qualifying hotels and provide a comparison (price, rating, neighborhood, cancellation terms, distance to center) and recommend one without booking. A reasonable user would be flexible if Booking.com only offers a per-night budget filter (not total), as long as the agent still selects hotels clearly under €750 total and completes the 3-hotel comparison and recommendation.
